finalText:
Build green. Exit 0.

Two real bugs from bump, sequential:

1. `src/core/options.js:7` — bundler renamed options field `retries` to `retryCount`. Call site read old name, got `undefined`, `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. Now reads `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old one returned `false`. Strict check threw `backoffEnabled must be a boolean, got undefined`. Now `undefined` means off; other non-boolean still throws.

Second one only surfaced after first fixed — hidden behind the crash.

Remaining 8 warnings not fixable from source: `build.js` emits them from hardcoded arrays (`DEPRECATIONS`, plus three `if (compiled === N)` lines), and they name files that don't exist in `src` (`src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`). Pure log noise from the fake bundler, no code behind them. Say the word if you want them muted in `build.js`.
